title: Orbital Liquid Glass Card
description: Multi-layer translucent container featuring 20px optical backdrop blur, saturated color enhancement, and fine specular top edge highlight.
htmlSnippet:
Liquid Glass Surface

Translucent optical depth with high-contrast text readability.
dependencies: Tailwind CSS v3+ or vanilla CSS3
browserCompatibility: Modern Chrome 90+, Safari 14+ (requires -webkit-backdrop-filter), Firefox 103+ with layout.css.backdrop-filter enabled.
accessibilityNotes: Maintains 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast ratio when pairing white text against the dark 75% opacity cosmic background.
responsiveBehavior: Adapts smoothly from full-width mobile cards to multi-column desktop grids.
performanceConsiderations: GPU compositing layer activated via backdrop-filter. Keep blur radius under 30px to prevent rendering lag on mobile devices.

title: Holographic Specular Glow Button
description: Tactile interactive button with vibrant cyan-to-blue gradient, fine specular edge lighting, and elevation hover states.
browserCompatibility: Universal support across all modern web browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
accessibilityNotes: Ensures visible focus rings using :focus-visible for keyboard navigation accessibility.
responsiveBehavior: Flex shrink-0 ensures button padding remains stable on constrained mobile viewports.
performanceConsiderations: Uses transform and filter transitions which run on the GPU compositor thread without triggering layout reflows.
